A1.justification: Both complete 15-page PDFs describe UniDrive-WM. Their text, equations, six figures, seven tables, and Appendices A-B are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Bench2Drive planning, perception, future-image generation, and VQA results, including component ablations and supplementary experiments in Tables 1-7.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the proposed model's benchmark scores, ablations, and qualitative examples in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The QT-Former, trajectory planner, AR and AR+Diffusion generators, training objectives, and training procedure are unchanged. The added Method heading labels existing content.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Bench2Drive coverage for planning, perception, and future-image prediction, plus Chat-B2D annotations for VQA. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1-3 and 5. This includes the retained planning comparisons with ORION, UniAD, and VAD, and image-generation comparisons with DriveGAN, DriveDreamer, Drive-WM, GEM, Doe-1, and FSDrive.

E3.justification: Both retain 950 training scenes, 50 open-loop validation scenes, and 220 closed-loop routes across 44 scenarios. Model configurations, image resolutions, training stages, and evaluation metrics are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablation in Table 4, AR versus AR+Diffusion comparison in Table 6, VQA ablation in Table 7, and qualitative examples in Figures 4-6 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting is retained throughout the main text and appendices.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1-7 and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Ours(AR) retains a driving score of 79.22 and success rate of 56.36%, while AR and AR+Diffusion retain FID values of 6.4 and 7.1.

T1.justification: Equations 1-15, their definitions, and the mathematical formulations of trajectory prediction, image generation, and losses are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain identical scientific claims, including unified understanding, planning, and generation and the claimed 5.9% L2-error and 9.2% collision-rate improvements.

C2.justification: Interpretations of image generation's benefits for planning and VQA remain unchanged. The AR versus AR+Diffusion trade-offs, resolution and token limitations, and proposed future extensions are also retained.

D1.justification: Hardware, LoRA settings, query counts, memory size, image processing, and Appendix B's QT-Former details are identical. The project-page link and resource-access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, all 51 references, and positioning relative to prior world models, unified image models, and vision-language-action models are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds the missing '3. Method' heading on page 3. Method subsections change from 2.1-2.4 to 3.1-3.4, Experiments becomes Section 4, and Conclusion becomes Section 5. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; substantive prose is unchanged.

P2.justification: The added Method heading causes localized text and equation reflow on page 3. Figures, tables, captions, and their placement remain unchanged, as does the supplementary layout.

improvement.justification: v2 repairs a small organizational defect: v1's methodology follows Related Works without its own section heading, whereas v2 clearly separates it and corrects the subsequent numbering. This modestly improves navigation and readability; scientific content, evidence, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
